Shutdown TODO does not make local Close safe. Replay: round-55 whole-repository replay; all selected modules scannable.

Early NXDOMAIN return requires errors.As of this exact acquisition error to succeed, which implies non-nil error. Every successful HTTP acquisition passes the subsequent error check and defers Body.Close; the errors.As implication is missed. Replay: round-55 whole-repository replay; all selected modules scannable.

The parent registers a dominating defer cancelMarketData, covering the outer-context and connection-failure return paths. This is a structurally cancellation-bound lifecycle, not an arbitrary missing join; the analyzer misses derived-local-context provenance. Replay: ./pkg/cmd; locally-canceled-context trace unknown.

Write assigns f from either os.Create or os.OpenFile, returns immediately on acquisition errors, and defers a closure receiving exactly the merged f and calling Close before writing. The merged selection has cleanup on all successful paths. Replay: round-55 whole-repository replay; all selected modules scannable.

The os.OpenFile branch joins the same f used as the explicit argument to the deferred f.Close closure. Both acquisition alternatives are released; the analyzer fails to credit the branch-merged resource cleanup. Replay: round-55 whole-repository replay; all selected modules scannable.

main closes inCh then ranges outCh until the exact worker closes it after draining input. NewRingBuffer merely stores both channels; the returned receiver's output field aliases the ranged channel, so worker completion is consumed. Replay: ./17-ring-buffer-channel; aggregate signal receive unknown.

DOHResolver.query closes the POST body via drainAndClose before replacing resp for a GET retry; without retry, non-OK responses are drained/closed and successful responses are closed on both ReadAll outcomes. Cleanup of a branch-selected response is not credited. Replay: round-55 whole-repository replay; all selected modules scannable.

The successful fallback GET response joins resp's merge; non-OK status uses drainAndClose, ReadAll error explicitly closes, and ReadAll success explicitly closes before unpacking. All successful acquisition paths release this body. Replay: round-55 whole-repository replay; all selected modules scannable.

Server.Start gives both listeners the same local WaitGroup initialized to2, then unconditionally waits. TCP listener calls Done after binding: this is an explicitly documented readiness signal, and its promised signal is consumed; the listener remains the server's long-lived work, not abandoned completion. Replay: round-55 whole-repository replay; all selected modules scannable.

Server.Start waits the exact two-listener WaitGroup; UDP calls Done after ListenPacket before serving indefinitely. The local group is a joined startup barrier, not an unfulfilled worker completion obligation. Replay: round-55 whole-repository replay; all selected modules scannable.

The temporary file is installed as a gomock Create return value; the test invokes avatarcopywrapper.copyAvatar, whose successful Create path immediately defers dst.Close. This is an opaque mock handoff with actual consumer cleanup, not a dropped local file. Replay: round-55 whole-repository replay; all selected modules scannable.

Init passes the opened file through zerolog.MultiLevelWriter and zerolog.New into the package-global logger, which retains it for later writes. This is an escaping logging sink rather than a function-local cleanup obligation; closing it at Init return would break logging. Replay: round-55 whole-repository replay; all selected modules scannable.
